name.en: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana

description.en: A renewable one-year term life-insurance scheme for eligible individual bank or post-office account holders, covering death due to any cause.

benefit_summary.en: Rs 2 lakh is payable to the nominee on the subscriber's death due to any cause. The current full-year premium shown by the official source is Rs 436 per subscriber, paid by auto-debit; first-time mid-year enrolment and the initial lien period have special rules.

eligibility_summary.en: An individual account holder aged 18 through 50 may join through one participating bank or post-office account. Cover can continue by annual renewal under the scheme's age and account conditions.

prompt.en: What is your age in completed years?
Do you have an individual account at a participating bank or post office?

description.en: The applicant is at least 18 years old.
The applicant is no more than 50 years old at entry.
The applicant has an eligible individual bank or post-office account.

name.en: Participating bank or post-office account details

instruction.en: Ask the participating bank or post office for the current PMJJBY terms and enrolment form.
Submit the consent and auto-debit authorisation through only one eligible account.
Keep the nominee details current and maintain enough balance for renewal.
